expected_observations.expectation: The anonymous source-faithful restore may fail at the configured Office feed; if it does, its downstream commands are blocked by that restore.
The public-only restore is expected to fail when Microsoft.Office.Lasso 2024.10.23.1 is unavailable from NuGet.org; its downstream commands are then blocked by that restore.
If a mode restore passes and the AzureAuth package command runs, it is expected to fail while the fixed checkout lacks AzureAuth.nuspec.

limitations: PCACacheTest was excluded because it performs real platform-persistence validation; this result does not establish an unfiltered upstream test-suite pass or PCACache/keyring/Keychain/DPAPI behavior.
The activation-v1 runner supports only WSL2 Linux x64. Native Linux, WSL1, Windows, macOS, and Linux arm64 are outside this protocol.

WSL interoperability remains a host capability, but child replacement environments omit WSL-specific variables and Windows PATH entries, and the fixed protocol selects only reviewed Linux executables. The result does not establish a Windows helper, broker, credential-provider, Windows-cache, or hostile-build-input isolation claim.
Activation v1 retains every created experiment selection and toolchain root. It does not reclaim stale roots, transfer cleanup authority, or perform destructive cleanup.

A failed restore, an absent or invalid project.assets.json, unproved child quiescence, source-integrity change, failed root identity, or a global sensitive-output or capture failure makes the affected dependency projection partial or unavailable and leaves its transitive scope unknown; no complete dependency conclusion may be inferred from that mode.
The recorded reproduction count is one. A single execution does not evaluate run-to-run variability, transient service behavior, or frequency.

conclusions.statement: The runner recorded the bounded WSL2-Linux-x64 command outcomes with source-faithful output suppressed, other output retained only when capture identity was verified, unverifiable captures contributing no output evidence, and only asset evidence admitted by the publication safety gates; public causality and evidence sufficiency remain review judgments.
